desc.BU_LB: long build-up (CE: price up 0.5%+ since the expiry close and OI since the day-1 close 2%+ above the market's; PE: short build-up - price down, OI up) - from day 2 (the OI leg starts at the day-1 close, after the expiry drop)
desc.BU_SC: short covering (CE: price up 0.5%+, OI since day 1 2%+ below the market's; PE: long unwinding - price down, OI down) - from day 2
desc.ROLL_HI: rollover proxy in the top third of the series (OI day 1 / OI the day before expiry, against the share's own last 6 series) - same for CE and PE
desc.ROLL_LO: rollover proxy in the bottom third - same for CE and PE
desc.SEC_TOP: its sector was in the top 3 of the previous series (PE: the bottom 3) - median move of the sector's shares, expiry to expiry
desc.BREADTH: 70%+ of its sector's shares rose over the previous series (PE: 70%+ fell)
desc.RSI_N: RSI regime normal: daily RSI(14) between 30 and 70 and within 10% of the 20-day average - same for CE and PE
desc.RSI_X: RSI regime EXTREME its way (CE: RSI >= 80 or 10%+ above the 20-day average; PE: RSI <= 20 or 10%+ below) - the plan's 'never'
desc.REV_OS: against the stretch (CE on an oversold share, RSI <= 30; PE on an overbought share, RSI >= 70) - the plan's 'do not, until measured'
desc.REV_X: against an EXTREME (CE on RSI <= 20 or 10%+ below the 20-day average; PE on EXTREME overbought) - the plan's 'do not'
desc.TREND: above both its 20- and 50-day averages (PE: below both)
desc.PULL: a pullback to the 20-day average (within 2% of it) while above the 50-day average (PE: below it) - the plan's entry zone
